_meanings:
The maternal uncle of {#aSvatTAmana#}. [He was born of the
 sage Śaradvat by a nymph called Jānapadī, but along with his sister
 Kṛpī, also born from the nymph, he was brought up by Śantanu. He was
 proficient in the science of archery. In the great war he sided with the
 Kauravas, and after all had been slain he was given an asylum by the Pāṇḍavas.
 He is one of the seven Chirajīvins.] {#kfpaSca samitiYjayaH#} <ls>Bg. 1. 8</ls>.
